about_the_game:
Try the Path!

The Path of the Ory

A Tale of Loss, Survival, and the Origins of a Legend

Before the rise of the Maid of Venia, before the kingdom’s last hope found her calling, there was a young survivor—Kayla. As a child, she lost everything. A group of ruthless bandits descended upon her village, slaughtering her family and leaving her for dead. But fate had other plans. From the shadows, an Ory warrior emerged, cutting down the bandits and taking Kayla under their wing. Now, years later, as the world teeters on the edge of chaos, Kayla must forge her own path.

In this 8-bit, retro-inspired RPG, embark on an unforgettable adventure through dense forests, ancient ruins, and lively towns, uncovering the roots of Venia’s impending war. The once-thriving kingdom has fallen into disarray after a coup led by powerful nobles dethroned the king, forcing the young prince into exile. Rumors whisper that he still lives, but his whereabouts remain unknown. Meanwhile, a dark mage has arrived in Venia, shrouded in mystery and menace. With dark forces rising, will Kayla stand as a lone warrior, or will she help shape the future of a fractured land?

Key Features

🕹 Classic 8-bit Graphics & Retro Gameplay – Experience a nostalgic yet rich RPG world, full of detail and charm, inspired by classic adventure games.

⚔️ Skill-Based Progression – Customize Kayla’s abilities. Will she become a skilled warrior, a cunning rogue, or a learned scholar? Choose which skills to develop and create a character that suits your playstyle.

🌲 Explore a Vast World – Journey through dense forests, deep dungeons, and vibrant villages, each filled with secrets, hidden treasures, and long-forgotten lore.

🏘 Live Among the People – Visit bustling towns where you can shop for gear, learn new skills, or simply listen in on local gossip—who knows what secrets the townsfolk might reveal?
